scope: Cut the core ID/EX and EX/MEM FP/NEON V forwarding cone into idex_d.neon_fp_operand_c and preserve precise RAW, load-use, FIFO, kill, backpressure, and commit semantics.

implementation.summary: fpv now uses architectural FP state plus MEM/WB registered V results only; v_id_reads combines scalar FP and NEON readers, including FMLA/FMLS Vd addend, and ex_id_v_hazard/exmem_v_hazard gate stall_id, flush_id, and fetch_fifo_pop.
